title: Football or Polo
question: What happened to the man in the boat?

meanings.usage: 指自然流动的水道，如 the Thames, the Yangtze River
指河流的岸边，也指银行金融机构
描述温度适中，不冷不热
指中午12点到傍晚之间的时间
child的复数形式，指年龄较小的人
指有规则的活动或体育运动
描述事情发生得很快且出乎意料
用脚踢球或其他物体的动作
形容正在经过某地的事物
指用力碰撞或击中某人或某物
表示非常接近但未完全达到
in sight 表示在视野范围内
指突然明白或发现某事

examples.en: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park.
examples.zh: 韦尔河是一条穿过我家附近公园的小河。

examples.en: I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
examples.zh: 我像往常一样去河边坐着。

examples.en: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat.
examples.zh: 岸上的一些人向船里的男人大声喊叫。

examples.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
examples.zh: 球重重地击中了他，他差点掉进水里。

examples.en: There weren't any in sight.
examples.zh: 一个人影也看不见。

examples.en: They had all run away!
examples.zh: 他们都跑走了！

examples.en: It went towards a passing boat.
examples.zh: 它朝一条经过的船飞去。

examples.en: He threw the ball back to the bank.
examples.zh: 他把球扔回岸上。

examples.en: Some children were playing games on the bank.
examples.zh: 一些孩子在岸上玩游戏。

examples.en: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在晴朗的下午坐在韦尔河边。

sentences.en: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home.
sentences.zh: 威勒河是一条小河，它横穿过我家附近的公园。

sentences.en: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在天气晴朗的下午坐在威勒河边。

sentences.en: It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
sentences.zh: 上个星期天天气很暖和，于是我像往常一样去坐在了河岸上。

sentences.en: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.
sentences.zh: 一些孩子在岸边玩游戏，河里有一些人在划船。

sentences.en: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it went towards a passing boat.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个孩子非常用力地踢了一个球，球飞向了一艘路过的船。

sentences.en: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them.
sentences.zh: 岸边的一些人向船上的那个人大声喊叫，但他没有听到。

sentences.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
sentences.zh: 球重重地打在他身上，他差点儿掉进水里。

sentences.en: I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!
sentences.zh: 我转身去看孩子们，但一个也看不见了：他们都跑掉了！

sentences.en: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.
sentences.zh: 当那个人意识到发生了什么事时，他笑了。

sentences.en: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
sentences.zh: 他冲孩子们喊了一声，把球扔回了岸边。

exercises.prompt: “意识到；认识到” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: realize · /ˈrɪəlaɪz/ · verb · 意识到；认识到。指突然明白或发现某事

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：河流
exercises.explain: river · /ˈrɪvə/ · noun · 河流。指自然流动的水道，如 the Thames, the Yangtze River

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：I like sitting by the Wayle _____.
exercises.hint: 我喜欢在晴朗的下午坐在韦尔河边。
exercises.explain: on fine afternoons：在晴朗的下午（我喜欢在晴朗的下午坐在韦尔河边。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：The ball struck him so _____ that he nearly fell into the water.
exercises.hint: 球重重地打在他身上，他差点儿掉进水里。
exercises.explain: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water. — 球重重地打在他身上，他差点儿掉进水里。

source.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.

exercises.prompt: “表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + 其他
options: so...that 引导的结果状语从句
exercises.explain: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)：主语 + had + 过去分词 + 其他：描述在过去的过去已经发生的事情

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The man laughed when he realized what had happened.
options: 我从不喜欢遇到奈杰尔·戴克斯。
当那个人意识到发生了什么事时，他笑了。
尽管他设法拍了许多精彩的照片，但他不能在火山附近待太久。
exercises.explain: The man laughed when he realized what had happened. — 当那个人意识到发生了什么事时，他笑了。

source.en: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.usage: 描述过去某一具体时间发生的动作或事件

examples.en: It was warm last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上个星期天天气很暖和。

examples.en: The ball struck him so hard.
examples.zh: 球重重地击中了他。

examples.en: He laughed when he realized what had happened.
examples.zh: 当他意识到发生了什么时，他笑了。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + 其他
grammar.usage: 描述过去正在进行的动作，常与 when, while 等连用

examples.en: Some children were playing games on the bank.
examples.zh: 一些孩子在岸上玩游戏。

examples.en: Some people were rowing on the river.
examples.zh: 河上有一些人在划船。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + 其他
grammar.usage: 描述在过去的过去已经发生的事情

examples.en: They had all run away before I could react.
examples.zh: 在我反应过来之前他们都已经跑走了。

examples.en: He realized what had happened.
examples.zh: 他意识到发生了什么（指在那个时刻之前就已经发生了）。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be动词(过去式) + 形容词 + 时间点

original.zh: 上个星期天天气很暖和。

examples.en: It was cold yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天天气很冷。

examples.en: It was sunny this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上天气晴朗。

original.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
original.zh: 球重重地击中了他，他差点掉进水里。

examples.en: She spoke so fast that nobody could understand her.
examples.zh: 她说得太快了，没人能听懂。

examples.en: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
examples.zh: 箱子太重了，我搬不动。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词(过去式) + when + 句子

original.en: He laughed when he realized what had happened.
original.zh: 当他意识到发生了什么时，他笑了。

examples.en: She cried when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 当她听到这个消息时，她哭了。

examples.en: The teacher smiled when he saw the students.
examples.zh: 当老师看到学生们时，他笑了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词(过去式) + ...to + 地点/人

original.en: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
original.zh: 他向孩子们喊叫，并把球扔回岸上。

examples.en: She waved to her friends.
examples.zh: 她向她的朋友们挥手。

examples.en: He shouted to the driver.
examples.zh: 他朝司机大声喊。
